draw.part.line: Right-click menu row on a partial structure (in parentheses). {delta} = normalized Δ (e.g. +O -H2), {formula} = formula with the Δ, {mass} = neutral mass, {mz} = m/z of [M+H]+.
draw.part.bad: Warning when the Δ written for a parenthesis cannot be read; {delta} = the text written.
draw.info.ringsValue: Value of the Rings row in the Information window of the Drawing. {n} = number of rings (cycles of the graph), {a} = how many are aromatic.
draw.link.title: Description (title) of the entries of the "PubChem" and "Other sites" submenus of the right-click menu in the Drawing. {host} = site name (e.g. pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov).
draw.info.copyOf: Accessible label of the Copy button in the Information window of the Drawing. {what} = name of the row (Formula, InChI, ...).
draw.ctx.head.sel: Accessible name (aria-label, not visible) of the right-click menu in the Drawing: what the menu acts on. {n} = number of selected atoms.
draw.ctx.copyFormula: Entry of the right-click menu on the label below a molecule; {formula} = formula with charge (e.g. C10H14N+).
draw.ctx.copyMass: As above, for the mass of a neutral molecule; {mass} = value already formatted.
draw.ctx.copyMassMz: As above, for an ion: the mass is an m/z.
draw.frag.col.formula: Column header of the cleavages table; {n} = 1 or 2, the fragment.
draw.frag.col.mz: Column header of the cleavages table; {n} = 1 or 2, the fragment; m/z of the [F+H]+ ion.
draw.anal.error: "Formula analysis" tab when the engine rejects the structure; {label} = the atom that has no formula or abundances.
draw.anal.stick: Accessible label of a stick of the isotope pattern; {peak} = M, M+1, ...; {x} = "m/z" or "Mass"; {mz} = the value; {rel} = % of the highest.
draw.anal.title: Title of the theoretical isotope pattern of the "Formula analysis" tab; {formula} = the drawn formula with the charge.
draw.frag.side: Right-click menu row on a bond: a fragment. {formula} = formula, {mass} = neutral mass, {mz} = m/z of [F+H]+.
draw.mech.end.atom: End of a mechanism arrow in the list; {atom} = symbol and number of the atom in the drawing (e.g. O3).
draw.mech.end.bond: Start or end of a mechanism arrow; {a} and {b} = the two atoms of the bond (e.g. C2, O3).
draw.mech.end.lone: Start of a mechanism arrow: a lone pair; {atom} = symbol and number of the atom.
draw.mech.end.radical: Start of a half-headed arrow: the radical; {atom} = symbol and number of the atom.
draw.mech.lp.bad: Status row of the mechanism: too many lone pairs on an atom. {atom} = atom, {pairs} = drawn, {max} = how many the atom can have.
draw.mech.remove.label: aria-label of the button that removes an arrow; {n} = number of the arrow in the list.
draw.mech.row: Row of the list of arrows; {n} = number, {kind} = pair or one electron, {from} and {to} = start and end (draw.mech.end.* texts).
draw.mech.start: Status row after "Start from the selection"; {end} = the chosen start (draw.mech.end.* texts).
draw.mech.added: Status row after a new arrow; {row} = its row of the list (draw.mech.row).
draw.mech.all.bad: Status row of the mechanism; {n} = number of arrows that are not well formed.
draw.cut.done: Status row after cutting bonds. {pieces} = the pieces, each with formula, type (radical, cation...) and mass, separated by semicolons.
draw.cut.hetero.row: Menu row after a heterolytic cut: which piece takes the + charge. {cation} and {anion} = formula, type and m/z of the two pieces.
draw.card.expand: Accessible name of the arrow button of a closed box of the Drawing; {name} = title of the box.
draw.card.collapse: Accessible name of the arrow button of an open box of the Drawing; {name} = title of the box.
draw.ctx.copySmilesOf: Entry of the right-click menu on the canvas; {smiles} = abbreviated SMILES.
draw.export.failed: Message below the export buttons when the export fails; {message} = technical error text.
draw.export.metaDesc.clear: Description field of the metadata of the exported PNG (transparent background); {scale} = scale factor.
draw.export.metaDesc.white: As above, with a white background.
draw.export.svgTitle.clear: <title> element of the exported SVG (transparent background); {app} = program name, {stamp} = date YYYY-MM-DD.
draw.export.svgTitle.white: As above, with a white background.
draw.import.failed: Notice below the SMILES field when pasting a structure fails; {message} = Ketcher text (English).
draw.import.changed: Notice under the SMILES field after a ChemDraw-format file was changed before Ketcher read it; {name} = file name or the words for pasted text, {what} = the changes, joined by semicolons.
draw.import.pasted: Stands for the file name in draw.import.changed when the structure was pasted.
draw.import.fix.empty: One change in draw.import.changed: attributes with an empty value were removed from the CDXML; {names} = their names.
draw.import.fix.replaced: One change in draw.import.changed: {count} bytes or characters of the file were not valid in its charset and became the replacement character (U+FFFD).
draw.import.fix.charset: One change in draw.import.changed: the file was not UTF-8 and was decoded as {charset}.
draw.import.unreadable: Notice below the SMILES field when a dropped structure file cannot be read; {name} = the file name.
draw.props.failed: Box of the predicted properties when the calculation fails; {message} = technical text.
draw.quick.invalid: Notice below "Quick draw" for a SMILES rejected by Ketcher; {message} = Ketcher text (English).
draw.quick.refused: Notice below "Quick draw" when the engine will not draw the SMILES; {message} = the engine's own error text (translated).
draw.quick.notFound: Notice below "Quick draw" when the text is neither a SMILES nor an InChI and no compound in the database has that name (or when a name is pasted onto the drawing).
draw.quick.count: Status read by screen readers below the "Quick draw" field when the compound search has found results; {n} = how many suggestions.
draw.selection.slow: Calm note in the SMILES tab of the selection when the Ketcher (Indigo) conversion does not answer within the time limit ({s} seconds): it names the limit, says what happened and the next step.
draw.selection.cuts: Note below the SMILES of the selection: number of bonds cut by the selection ({n}).
draw.export.filePrefix: Prefix of the name of the downloaded files (drawing_YYYY-MM-DD_HHMM.png): only lowercase letters without accents.
draw.export.transparentSuffix: Suffix of the name of the files with a transparent background: only lowercase letters without accents.
draw.error: Text on the chart when the drawing fails; {message} = technical text.
